prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a premium Chinese product lifecycle diagram for an enterprise knowledge engine proposal, landscape 3:2 high resolution, white background, crisp legible simplified Chinese, navy headings, refined teal/indigo accents, muted amber review gates. Same polished enterprise editorial style as professional product architecture diagrams: generous spacing, aligned cards, thin clear noncrossing arrows, restrained line icons, no watermark. Title exact「正式知识的版本与历史生命周期」. Subtitle exact「业务有效性与存储状态分开管理」. Upper half titled「业务版本」. Show left-to-right states with numbered simple cards:「候选修订」→「审核发布」→「待生效」→「当前有效」→「已替代或已停用」. Above '当前有效' a compact note「同一对象，按条件与时间选版本」. Below '当前有效' a side branch arrow down to a small muted red card「风险限用」 with note「发现错误先止用」. Under upper row a full width short sentence「新版生效后，旧版退出默认回答；内容、条件、证据和批准记录保留。」. Lower half titled「历史保管」. Show a separate left-to-right process with five clearly spaced cards:「在线历史」→「归档评估」→「已归档」→「到期评审」→「批准处置」. Under '归档评估' short labels「观察期届满」「无实时执行依赖」「归档包完整」. Under '已归档' short labels「受控查阅」「可校验取回」. Under '到期评审' short labels「保留期限届满」「依赖与保全检查」. Under '批准处置' short labels「有权人员批准」「保留处置证明」. A separate subtle arrow from upper '已替代或已停用' to lower '在线历史' labelled「转入历史使用」. Show a muted amber review branch below '到期评审' leading to a compact card「延长保留或继续保全」. Avoid adding a direct path from active knowledge to deletion. Bottom two important notes, exact:「归档不等于删除；恢复归档不等于重新生效。」 and「归档等待期与保留期限分别配置，以替代、停用或结案等已确认事件起算。」. All exact Chinese must be correctly rendered. Do not put any invented number of years or imply archival automatic reapproval. Make the different two lifecycle rows and review gates unmistakable, ample margins, no dense paragraphs.
review: Model output visually checked; lifecycle labels and two separate state tracks match proposal. Prior three diagrams and prompts retained in knowledge-product-v33-image-prompts.json.
